newsitem.title: USA: Conseco offers 8.796 pct capital securities.
newsitem.headline: Conseco offers 8.796 pct capital securities.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Wednesday that its Conseco Financing Trust III subsidiary offered $300 million of 8.796 percent capital securities at $1,000 per security.
Each capital security will pay cumulative cash distributions at the annual rate of 8.796 percent of the stated $1,000 liquidation amount per security, payable semi-annually starting October 1, 1997.
Conseco Financing Trust III will use proceeds to acquire an equivalent amount of 8.796 percent subordinated deferrable interest debentures due April 1, 2027, to be issued by Conseco.
Proceeds from the offering of about $296.7 million will be used to repay bank debt.
